issues.on_page: Transfers From Other Funds 101,000.00; Non-Revenue Receipts 30,608,073.18 (includes Depreciation 500,000.00 and Employee Benefit 30,290.51)
issues.issue: The extractor assumed the '5200 Allocation from General Fund' receipts (500,000 on p14, 30,290.51 on p15) are transfers. The report itself counts them as Non-Revenue Receipts (p5) and as 'Other' general receipts (p3). The General Fund roll-forward (pp8, 10, 26) has no matching outflow, so governmental transfers_in exceeds transfers_out by 530,290.51. decision_needed already asks about this. Totals and the roll-forward still tie: 10,992,349.50 -> 33,334,957.51.

split_from is set on a line that is printed as-is and was not split. The signed -70,000 and the detail_totals 'includes: other financing' are right, but this tag will wrongly put the line on the review list as a split. It should carry no split_from (or a printed_in note instead).

issues.on_page: 2310 Board of Education - Other Property Services 186,093.01
issues.issue: Every 'Other Property Services' line in Schedule M is mapped to professional/contract services. For Board of Education (186,093.01) and the SPED programs, this object is often insurance, tuition paid to other districts or other purchased services. This is a judgment call.
